reels.creator: veronicabahl
reels.caption:
THE CHOCOLATE CAKE THAT’S ACTUALLY BREAKFAST 🍫🥒

I finally decided to make my own after having one of the best zucchini chocolate cakes at Chorus Café in Bombay a couple of weeks ago. That’s where the inspiration for this recipe came from. ❤️

RECIPE ↓

Ingredients:
• 50g rolled oats
• 75g green zucchini, grated
• 2 whole eggs OR 1 whole egg + 4 egg whites
- 1 tea spoon baking powder and half tea spoon baking soda 
• 40g banana
• 40ml almond milk
• 30g cocoa powder
• 30g sugar-free sweetener

METHOD:

Add the oats, grated zucchini, eggs (if using 2 whole eggs), banana, almond milk, cocoa powder and sweetener to a blender. Blend until completely smooth.

If the batter feels too thick, add a little water and blend again. You want it to be smooth, thick but still runny enough to pour.

If you’re using 1 whole egg + 4 egg whites, whisk the egg whites separately until slightly fluffy, then gently fold them into the blended batter.

This makes the cake lighter and airier.

I personally prefer using 2 whole eggs because it makes the cake denser, richer and more mousse-like. 🤌🏼

Grease an oven/air-fryer-safe dish with one spray of olive oil and line with baking paper. Pour in the batter.

BAKE:
200°C for 20 minutes
then 250°C for another 5–10 minutes.

Every oven/air fryer is different, so check it as you go. Insert a fork into the centre — it should come out clean when the cake is cooked through.

TOP IT OFF 🍓🫐

I HIGHLY recommend a mountain of fresh + frozen berries. The tartness cuts through the dense, mousse-y chocolate cake SO well.

Roasted dry fruits also work beautifully if that’s more your thing.

reels.caption:
15 cals dark choc brownie bites for the snacky gals out here. 

before anyone comes for me: 15 cals is MY number because i cut mine into a 9x9 grid. cut yours bigger, cut yours smaller, the math bends to your knife.

anyway. i made brownie bites and they are gooey little reminders that all the good stuff can be made at home. 

the dry team:
100g gluten free plain flour (Yes You Can)
30g Dutch processed cocoa (Ossoro)
1 scoop Func Lab chocolate plant protein (use code ANKITA on website for a discount)
30g sugar free cook & bake 
a little baking soda + a little baking powder
2-3g zero sugar chocolate pudding mix
2 spoons zero sugar Bourn Vita
sift all of that. 

the good stuff:
40g Amul bitter chocolate + 4 Royce discs + 40g Amul light butter. microwave it, then let it come back to room temp before you touch it again. patience.
4 egg whites, whipped to stiff peaks. the airier the better, this is the whole 

putting it together:
fold the egg whites into the dry mix. when it needs moisture, start adding almond milk (i used 137 degrees). measure with your heart. grease your pan with a bit of olive oil. oven preheated to 180 for 10-15 mins.
fold in the whites, fold in the milk, then the cooled chocolate butter mix.
bake 20 mins. skewer test, kill the oven when there are barely any crumbs on the stick.
do NOT rip it out of the pan immediately. let it cool, chop it up, fridge it so the chocolate and butter set into gooey goodness. serve on a cake stand if ur fancy like me. 

enjoy. don’t @ me about the calories.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ or you can. I have done the math too many times.

reels.creator: fit.khurana
reels.caption:
Recipe ⬇️
Ingredients - 

(25g Protein, 11g fiber, 422 cals)

✅For the filling - 
Boiled rajma – 100g
Tofu - 70-80g
Red chilli powder – ½ tsp
Black pepper – ¼ tsp
Jeera powder – ½ tsp
Salt to taste
Schezwan chutney – 1 tsp

Whole wheat tortilla or chapati – 1
Oil – 1 tsp (for cooking)

For the yogurt sauce - 
Greek yogurt – 2–3 tbsp
Chilli sauce – 1 tbsp

For the salsa - 
Tomato – 2-3 tbsp finely chopped
Fresh coriander – a handful
Lemon juice – 1 tbsp
Ketchup – ½ tbsp (optional)
Salt to taste

How to Prep ⬇️
🌸Mash the boiled rajma and tofu together with chilli powder, pepper, jeera powder, salt, and schezwan chutney until well combined.
🌸Slightly cook the tortilla on one side. Flip, spread the rajma–tofu mixture evenly on the cooked side, drizzle a little oil, and cook until golden and slightly crispy on both sides. 
🌸Mix Greek yogurt and chilli sauce to make a quick creamy sauce.
🌸In another bowl, mix tomato, coriander, lemon juice, ketchup, and salt to make the salsa. 
🌸Layer the sauce and salsa over the tortilla, fold into half, cut, and serve hot🔥

✅Should I do more wraps/tacos or sandwiches? Jaldi batao⬇️

reels.caption:
Recipe ⬇️ (447 Cals, 40g P)

Ingredients - 2 Toasties

🧀 80g High Protein Paneer (used ID)
🍞 2 Slices Double Protein Bread (Used Protein Chef)
🌶️ 2-3 tbsp Pizza Pasta Sauce
🌽 Sweet Corn 1 tbsp
🍄 Mushrooms 2-3
🫑 Capsicum 3 tbsp
🧅 Onion 5-6 slices
🧀 20-30g Mozzarella Cheese

How to Make -

1. Airfry the bread slices at 180 for 3-4 mins until you are chopping veggies.
2. Spread 1-1.5 tbsp Pizza Sauce on each slice.
3. Coat the paneer in 1/2 tsp olive oil, salt and pepper and add to the toasties. 
4. Top with corn, mushrooms, capsicum and onion.
5. Add the mozzarella cheese on top.
6. Air fry at 180 for another 4-5 mins until cheese gets golden brown.

reels.caption:
Recipe🔽 (30g Protein - Kebabs + Greek Yogurt Dip)

1. Boil 35g of Soya Chunks and properly squeeze them to drain out all the water
2. In a kadhai, add 1 tsp ghee, 1 tsp jeera, 2-3 cloves chopped garlic and 2 chopped chillies
3. Then add 1 small chopped onion. Let it cook for 2 mins and add 1 cup fresh peas (incase you use frozen peas, soak in lukewarm water for a while).
4. Let the peas cook for 5 minutes and then add salt, 1 tsp red chilli powder, 1 tsp aamchur, 1 tsp garam masala, 1/2 tsp coriander powder, pinch of haldi and some rock salt.
5. Mix well and then add a tbsp of rice flour. Mix again and transfer this to a grinder jar. Add 1/2 slice of bread and handful of coriander and grind this mixture into a fine paste.
6. To this, add the soya chunks and grind again
7. Now keep this paste in the fridge for 10 minutes and apply oil on your hands and start making small balls.
8. On a non stick pan, brush some ghee and cook this kebabs on low-medium flame for a few minutes and until they have this beautiful brown color.
9. Serve with greek yogurt for more protein. Top the yogurt with red chilli powder, chaat masala and pomegranate (my star ingredient which goes so well with these)
